FY29funding will pay to hire an architect to fully redesign bathrooms, develop a template which can be replicated systemwide. title: Architect for Spofford Elementary Schools Restrooms Repair
short_description: Architectural redesign and ADA-compliant reconstruction of elementary school restrooms in Boxford.
project_scope: Redesign and reconstruction of restrooms at Spofford Elementary School, based on the Kessler McGuiness & Associates ADA Accessibility Study. Affected areas include bathrooms in Rooms 101, 102, 206, 208, 209, 210, 211, 213, the Health Office, and Upper Level Boys & Girls restrooms. Works include ADA accessibility upgrades such as insulating sink pipes, repositioning grab bars, flush valves and toilets, installing auto-flush controls, tactile/Braille signage, relocating paper towel dispensers and stall partitions, replacing four thresholds, and further study of additional bathroom features. The consultant is also to develop a bathroom redesign template replicable systemwide.
services: Architectural services for restroom redesign; preparation of a replicable bathroom template; interior design/space planning; programming; rehabilitation and refurbishment; possible civil engineering support.
